content:
Amanda L.: Heads-up — Lyra Data private deployment target tonight 21:00 PST. Need final approval on runtime pin and KMS rotation timing.
pm-ryan: Plan: pin inference-runtime v2.5.0, canary 3% for 20m. Rollback if p99 > 300ms OR error rate > 1.0% for 10m.
Sri P.: Security scheduled KMS key rotation at 23:00 PST. That could overlap with our 2h post-deploy checks. Prefer to rotate before cutover but we may need an exception.
Jonah K.: Ops preference is to push KMS rotate to 02:00 PST to avoid overlap. We'll need a signed exception if security insists on earlier.
Elena M.: infra has an unrelated control-plane maintenance at 22:30 in ap-south, not in our region.
infra-oncall: confirmed no infra maintenance affecting us in us-west tonight.
Amanda L.: Lyra legal ok with a scoped maintenance exception but asked for max 3-hour delay. They want a detailed rollback plan.
DeployBot: deploy request received: project=lyra-data env=private target=dedicated slice=lyra-01 image=inference-runtime:v2.5.0
DeployBot: initiating canary rollout (3% traffic) -> 21:05 PST
Sri P.: please include a KV-cache warmup during canary to avoid token spikes. Config proposal:
```
prewarm: true
batch_timeout_ms: 8
kv_cache_populate: 250
```
pm-ryan: accepted. Update runbook and attach rollback playbook pointer.
Amanda L.: runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/lyra-1752468000
DeployBot: canary 3% up @21:07 PST — metrics: p50=85ms p95=160ms p99=210ms errors=0.09%
Jonah K.: doing smoke tests now.
Jonah K.: smoke OK. Monitoring for 20m.
DeployBot: canary window elapsed 20m @21:27 PST — no regressions observed.
Amanda L.: proceeding to 25% at 21:30, hold for 15m then to full if stable.
DeployBot: traffic to 25% @21:31 PST.
infra-oncall: small blip during 25% shift, p99 to 325ms for ~1.5m, then back to baseline.
Sri P.: blip observed but below rollback threshold. Continue with caution.
DeployBot: traffic to 100% @21:50 PST. Applying pin to v2.5.0
Amanda L.: Lyra confirms no client errors. KMS rotation moved to 02:00 PST under exception (max 3h). @pm-ryan please sign off.
pm-ryan: sign-off. Conditions: post-deploy health checks every 15m for 3h, rollback window 3h. KMS rotate at 02:00 PST.
Elena M.: filing exception with security and will create audit entry.
DeployBot: deployment complete @21:52 PST — summary: canary->full, pinned=inference-runtime:v2.5.0, rollback_not_triggered, metrics_ok.
Amanda L.: thanks all. I'll keep monitoring overnight and will ping if anything pops. :white_check_mark:
